selection: All recorded Electric, Electric + TanStack DB and Jazz v2 cases; Zero except local-query and deep-relationship-query. All SQL-adapter cases and the two Zero screen cases are replaced by the new campaigns.
limitations: The source campaign stopped at 470 of 1120 planned attempts and was withdrawn. These 4–5-attempt case histories are retained without promoting the stopped campaign to complete or pooling them with new measurements. Jazz remains experimental. This catalog reports outcomes, not new performance estimates.
